sections.description: A self-hosted, context-aware website guide with customer-owned AI billing and WordPress data.
sections.changelog:
1.0.9

  • Restore chat when attachments are intentionally unavailable.
  • Hide Delete chat until a conversation exists.

1.0.8

  • Permanent download links.

1.0.7

  • Stop an open section from clipping tooltips.

1.0.6

  • Clearer plugin description.
  • Hide the attachment control, which this edition does not yet read.

1.0.5

  • Answers stream in as they are written.
  • Fix the send and stop icons.

0.8.9

  • Panel colour and opacity, gradient colours, mark sizes, and the note under the message box are all settings.
  • Each mark is previewed on the surface it lands on.
  • The preview answers as the assistant you are configuring.

0.8.2

  • Ship the guide from abatchan.com itself, not a smaller copy.
  • Attachments, streamed answers, formatted replies, per-message feedback.
  • Isolated from the theme it lands in.

0.7.0

  • Try Nika on the settings page itself while the site stays hidden from visitors.
  • Every setting applies to it as you type, with no save and no reload.
  • Keep a white mark visible in the image previews.

0.6.4

  • Make the image picker button visible on the settings card.

0.6.3

  • Set your own header logo and bubble icon from the media library.

0.6.2

  • Keep answering after the first question in a conversation.

0.6.1

  • Recover the answer when a provider replies in an unexpected shape or stops at the token ceiling.
  • Offer proposed navigation even when the reply carried no prose.

0.6.0

  • Send with Enter, new line with Shift+Enter.
  • Highlight the requested section after arrival even when the address gains a trailing slash.

0.5.9

  • Use the same visitor composer across WordPress and Universal installs.
  • Add Ask first, Allow actions, Concise, and Detailed modes.
  • Keep conversations through approved navigation and improve late section highlighting.
